Receiva · Unlock your private receive keys Signing is free. It sends nothing and moves nothing. This signature stays in your browser. Network: Robinhood Chain (4663) Key version: 1
Receiva gives you a private receive link. Every payment lands in a fresh address that only you can open. No pool, no custody, no mixer.
Receiva is a thin layer over two Ethereum standards whose contracts were already live on Robinhood Chain before Receiva existed.
Receiva is open-source software, not a bank or broker. Amounts and senders remain public on-chain. Not financial advice. Unaudited; use at your own risk.
Receiva is open-source software, not a bank or broker. Unaudited; use at your own risk.
Receiva uses stealth addresses (ERC-5564). It breaks the on-chain link between a payment and the person who receives it. It does not make transactions invisible. Here is the full picture.
Receiva works with any EVM wallet on Robinhood Chain.
Registering a short link publishes your public keys next to your address. Incoming payments are still unlinkable.

Robinhood stock tokens are issued with controls: the issuer can pause transfers or block addresses. Receiva cannot override this. Timing and amount patterns can also hint at who received a payment; vary them if that matters to you.
Router unit tests and the full app flow (register, send ETH, send NVDA, scan, withdraw) passed on a fork of Robinhood Chain using the live Announcer and real NVDA stock tokens.

The 0x short link names your wallet to whoever you share it with. The long link does not.

The full code behind receiva.xyz is public: the router, the cryptography, the app and the indexer. The router compiled from that repository is byte-for-byte identical to the one deployed on Robinhood Chain; the README shows how to check it in one command.
The note comes from the link you opened. It is not written on-chain.
The note lives only in the link. It is never written on-chain. Amounts are public once paid, like any transfer.
The payer signs a normal transaction from their own wallet.
The Receiva Router is under 80 lines. No owner, no fee, no admin switch, no upgrade path. It forwards a payment and logs one announcement. That is all it can do.
The sender. Each token payment carries a tiny amount of ETH (0.00002) to the one-time address, so you can withdraw without funding it first.
The short link is your wallet address. Whoever you share it with knows the payment is for that wallet. The chain still does not link the payment to it. Share the long link to avoid this.

Your funds stay where they are. Announcements live on Robinhood Chain, and your keys come back from one signature, so any ERC-5564 tool can find and move them.
Your Inbox finds each payment and moves it in one click, gas included by the sender. Send it to a fresh wallet to stay hooded.

Your keys come from your wallet's signature of this exact text. Signing it costs nothing and authorizes nothing. If any site asks you to sign it, it can derive your Receiva keys, so sign it only on receiva.xyz.
